summary: Two dated catalysts sit on the held book this week. Nvidia reports 11-17, one trading day out (QQQ/VOO/VTI concentration), and WMT's company-confirmed print is 11-19, three trading days out. WMT also filed an 8-K 5.02 today that I can't read from item numbers, so its content is unknown on the eve of the print. Crypto fell for a fifth leg, with BTC near $64K after a weekend of liquidations and ETF outflows, but no exchange failed. The held-name news otherwise is the INCY Phase 3 cancellation (company says guidance is unaffected), Morgan Stanley's EXEL target cut to $57, below the $69.04 fill, and supportive target raises on KR, MSCI and WMT. Per L2, every symbol in the input is covered below with its own date and filings.

event_risk.why: Held. Q3 release and call 11-19 are company-confirmed (11-12 item; the file estimate agrees), 3 trading days out (11-17, 18, 19), so any add carries high risk. New today: an 8-K 5.02/9.01 filed 11-16 (document dated 11-13) with no explaining headline. It could be a director appointment or an executive departure; I can't tell which from item numbers, and it lands three days before the print. The PM should read it before relying on the WMT thesis. Today's 'What's Going On With Walmart Stock Monday?' piece says shares are up premarket and doesn't mention it. PT drift continues: BNP Paribas to $144 from $137 (11-16) and Wells Fargo $135 (11-13), on top of the 9+ raises noted 11-13. The bar is high, and a close-based stop does not protect against a gap on the print (L7).

Nvidia reports 11-17, 1 trading day out (date from earlier Benzinga items; today's input doesn't restate it). It is the first print under interim CEO Kress after Huang's resignation. New policy pressure: Treasury Secretary Bessent is pressing Nvidia over China chips (11-16 premarket), and today's analyst roundup includes more NVDA target cuts. On 11-13 the post-Huang chip rotation unwound: AMD fell 10.5% and the Nasdaq 100 fell 1.7%. Polymarket put a higher S&P open at 38% this morning. Caveat from my graded record: QQQ high flags graded wrong at 5 days in most cases since 10-30 (including 11-06). This is event risk around a dated print, not a direction call.

Fifth leg down since 11-09: $75K, $73K, below $69K on 11-13, below $70K/$68K Friday, and $64K this morning after a 'brutal weekend selloff' (Benzinga: down about 25%, heavy liquidations). The crypto market lost about $750B in days, Fear & Greed is 17, spot crypto ETFs lost $1.48B in five days (BTC $1.06B), and CZ cites $1.9B in outflows. O'Leary and CZ blame capital rotating to AI and the Anthropic IPO. The Polymarket $65K target from 11-13 has effectively been hit. Exchange-failure clause: untripped, since no exchange failed in this input. Calls for $40K (Cowen) and sub-$10K (Schiff) are opinion. Not held since the ~11-09 sale per the lessons file.

Raised from medium because there are now ETH-specific items: a death cross, ETH ETF outflows and a dive in futures open interest (11-14). It is also on every crypto-crash roundup. No exchange or protocol failure.

Estimated earnings 11-23 (last year + 364 days, approximate), now 5 trading days out (11-17, 18, 19, 20, 23), so it is inside the window for a new buy. The 8-K 5.02/9.01 filed 11-10 is still unread with no headline; that open question has carried since 11-11. Not known to be held.

Held. No VOO-specific event. Nvidia, the S&P's largest weight, reports 11-17. Rates: the 10-year was at 5.15% (week of 11-13), traders now price Fed hikes in December and January, and yields climbed again over the weekend. PPI was cooler on 11-13, which offsets slightly. Flows remain strong ('VOO & Chill', the $37.5B five-day ETF inflow), and SCHD's $27.5B inflow is read as rotation away from AI. My 11-06 high VOO flag graded wrong.
Held. Same backdrop as VOO, including the NVDA 11-17 print; tagged only in the ETF-inflow story.

Held (restated 11-13 as a low-volatility reserve, not a hedge). There is a new datum on the hike path: traders now bet on hikes in both December and January, and the 10-year reached 5.15%. The cooler 11-13 PPI is the only offsetting datum. The next dated event is the 12-09 FOMC, outside the window.
Same thread as BND at the longest duration: the 10-year was at 5.15% and hikes are priced for December and January. No TLT-tagged item. The 12-09 FOMC is outside the window.

Continues the 11-13 break below $4,000. Goldman trimmed its 2026 target and says to wait until 2027, GLD ETF outflows are building, gold sits at 'key support' on Fed-hike risk, and China is adding reserves below $4,000 (a partial floor). No dated event. The file's 11-24 'earnings' date is a data artifact for an ETF.

Held since 11-11. An 8-K 8.01 filed 11-13 matches the headline: Incyte will not proceed with the planned Phase 3 MAESTRA-3 study of INCB123667. The company says this does not affect its financial guidance or long-term outlook, so a guidance-cut clause is not tripped on the company's own statement. It is still a pipeline setback on a fresh position. Reported 10-29; next 2027-02-09 (file estimate).
The 8-K 5.02 filed 11-12 (document dated 11-10) is still unread, with no headline. Check it before any FTDR proposal. Next 2027-02-25. Not known to be held.

notable.headline: 8-K items 5.02/9.01 filed 2026-11-16 (document dated 11-13), no headline
notable.read: This is the first 5.02 on a held name in weeks, and it lands three trading days before a confirmed print. Until the content is known, an executive departure can't be ruled out. It continues the WMT pre-print thread (dates flagged 11-10 to 11-13), which so far has been all bullish PT drift.

notable.headline: BNP Paribas Adjusts Price Target on Walmart to $144 From $137; Walmart Stock Forms a Golden Cross as Valuation Worries Linger Ahead of Earnings
notable.read: Another pre-print raise, roughly the eleventh in seven sessions. Consensus is crowded, so the print has to clear a high bar.

notable.headline: Incyte Has Decided Not To Proceed With The Planned Phase 3 MAESTRA-3 Study Evaluating INCB123667; Company Does Not Expect This Determination To Affect Its Financial Guidance
notable.read: A pipeline negative on a position bought 11-11, backed by the 8-K 8.01 of 11-13. The company explicitly keeps guidance, so it is not a guidance cut. It matters for the oncology pair (INCY+EXEL) the PM sized as one exposure.

notable.headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Equal-Weight on Exelixis, Lowers Price Target to $57
notable.read: A target below both the $69.04 fill and the $65 stop on a position bought 11-13. Not an event, but it adds to the INCY item for the Health Care/oncology sleeve the same day.

notable.headline: Stock Market Today: Dow Jones, S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 Futures Trade Fall as Scott Bessent Presses Nvidia Over China Chips
notable.read: A new policy angle on Nvidia the day before its 11-17 print, adding to the Huang resignation thread (11-09 to 11-13). It follows Friday's chip unwind (AMD -10.5%, Nasdaq 100 -1.7%), so the 11-13 'index absorbed it' read lasted one session.

notable.headline: Bitcoin Drops to $64,000 After Brutal Weekend Selloff: What Is Going On?
notable.read: The fifth leg of the thread that began 11-09. Each downside warning in news_memory ($73K, $70K, $65K Polymarket) has played out within days. The drivers are flows (ETF outflows, liquidations, rotation to AI/Anthropic IPO) and rates, not an exchange failure.

notable.headline: Ethereum Flashes Death Cross as ETF Outflows Surge, Futures Open Interest Dives
notable.read: The first ETH-specific item in the window. ETH is no longer only riding BTC's tags.

notable.headline: Behind the Rising US Bond Yields: Traders Bet on Fed Hikes in December and January, a Blow to Trump
notable.read: This extends the CPI thread (11-10 onward) from one hike to two, with the 10-year at 5.15%. It bears on BND and the equity sleeves; the 11-13 cooler PPI is the only offsetting datum.

notable.headline: Goldman Sachs Says Wait With Gold Until 2027; China Isn't Listening
notable.read: Continues the 11-13 sub-$4,000 break. A major-bank target trim and GLD outflows against central-bank buying. It is a regime question, not a dated event.

notable.headline: Evercore ISI Group Maintains Outperform on Kroger, Raises Price Target to $75
notable.read: Supportive on a held name after the 11-13 add, following Goldman's $77. No event before the 12-03 call.

notable.headline: RBC Lowers Price Target on CVS Health to $108 From $113
notable.read: The fourth negative revision since 11-10 (Argus, Wells Fargo, the Deutsche Bank downgrade, RBC). The post-print drift is persistent but is a trend, not an event.

notable.headline: ExlService Form 4 Filing Showed Chairman And CEO Rohit Kapoor Sold 100,000 Shares At $43.24
notable.read: The Form 144 flagged on 11-13 has executed, closing that item. A mild negative.
